Product Features
Lifelike full spruce: Designed with full spruce shape, featuring mostly tips mould from natural branches, this realistic Christmas tree beautifully recreates the natural charm for a truly authentic festive feel in your home.
Impressive fullness: With 1814 densely packed tips across 99 cm width, this 6 ft Christmas tree creates a beautifully silhouette far fuller than standard trees with only 950-1300 tips, bringing a rich presence.
Easy assembly: With a simple sections design, hinged branches and mould branches (required little shaping), putting up this Christmas tree is quick and tool-free, for about 15-20 minutes giving you more time for family festivities.
Flame-retardant branches: Crafted from tested with fire-retardant properties, each branch is designed for safe enjoyment year after year. Place the fake Christmas tree beside your fireplace and bask in the warm, inviting glow without concerns.
Stable and foldable stand: Equipped with a reinforced metal base, the 6 foot Christmas tree stays upright and secure. Foldable design allows for incredibly easy storage once the festivities are over.

Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

8941467517224.sourceDescription:
Thin sheet decorations rattle like scrap metal. These are bronze plated with a wall thick enough to ring properly, so a gentle shake gives a clear note rather than a clatter. Each bell has a small hole at the top, which means it goes onto cord, ribbon or copper wire in seconds. For a wreath, thread alternating sizes around a wire hoop and tie a ribbon at each end, because all one size hangs lopsided. On a tree, hang them near the trunk rather than at the tips, since even a light bell bends a thin branch. If you paint them to match a colour scheme, use a thin coat and let it cure for a full day before hanging.
20 bells per pack
Bronze plated metal, antique finish
Clear ringing tone, not a rattle
Top hole takes cord or ribbon
Can be painted to suit a theme
For tree, wreath, wedding, door
Suitable for outdoor use
Patina develops with age

Christmas Wreath
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5056899203324.sourceDescription:
Bring a cheerful seasonal glow to your home with this Wallace and Gromit LED picture frame, featuring the much-loved pair decorating a Christmas tree alongside a crowned penguin. In the colourful festive scene, Wallace wears his familiar green knitted vest, Gromit carries a box of bright ornaments and the penguin adds a mischievous finishing touch beside the twinkling branches. The full-colour artwork is surrounded by a rich dark wood-effect frame, bringing character to a mantelpiece, shelf, sideboard or hallway console. Choose from three LED light settings, natural, warm and cool, to suit your surroundings, from a balanced glow to cosy golden illumination or a crisp winter tone. A convenient touch button on the side lets you change the lighting without moving the frame. Measuring approximately 22.5cm high x 16.5cm wide x 4cm deep, its portrait format fits neatly into seasonal arrangements. Powered by 3 x AA batteries (not included), it can be positioned without a nearby mains socket or trailing lead. A charming decorative accent and gift idea for fans of the iconic duo.
Celebrate the festive season with Wallace and Gromit decorating a colourful Christmas tree alongside a crowned penguin, creating a cheerful, character-filled scene for your home.
The vibrant full-colour artwork features Wallace in his green knitted vest, Gromit with a box of decorations and a brightly illuminated tree, all finished with an elegant dark wood-effect surround.
Choose between three LED lighting settings, natural, warm and cool, to enjoy a balanced glow, a cosy golden ambience or a crisp wintry tone that complements your festive decorations.
A discreet touch button positioned on the side makes switching between lighting modes quick and convenient, while battery operation allows flexible placement without a trailing power cable.
Measuring approximately 22.5cm high x 16.5cm wide x 4cm deep, this compact portrait frame suits mantelpieces, shelves and sideboards. Requires 3 x AA batteries, which are not included.

5059442204724.baseName: Norway Spruce Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Fresh Living Potted Plant - 2ft (60cm)
5059442204724.variantName: Norway Spruce Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Fresh Living Potted Plant - 2ft (60cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 2ft
5059442204724.sourceDescription:
Norway Spruce has the unmistakable shape of a traditional Christmas tree, with dark green foliage, a neat conical outline, and branches that angle upwards to create a naturally attractive silhouette. The stiff, pointed needles give it a distinctly spruce-like appearance, while the strong branches provide plenty of support for your favourite decorations. A strong pine fragrance completes the experience, bringing the familiar scent of a real Christmas tree into the home.
STRONG, UPWARD-FACING BRANCHES: The branches of Norway Spruce angle upwards to create its characteristic Christmas-tree shape, while their strength provides good support for lights, baubles, and other decorations. The natural spacing also allows the shape of the tree to remain visible once it is decorated.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH A PINE SCENT: Norway Spruce has the distinctive fragrance associated with traditional spruce trees, adding a natural Christmassy scent to the room that adds to the magic of the season.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: Once the festive period is over, move the tree outdoors where it can continue growing. Its evergreen foliage provides year-round colour, making it suitable for inclusion among evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH ROOM TO DEVELOP: The container provides a practical way to keep the tree growing while it is still young, without committing immediately to a permanent planting position. These live potted Christmas trees can therefore be enjoyed as Christmas trees while also being given the opportunity to become a long-term feature in the garden.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
